capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（三龙之一）挑战塔克林，打败获得塔克林精元（孵化得塔米）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先用丽莎布布叶绿光束等消掉天生物攻+2，再降它物攻；用毒粉、漩涡、火焰漩涡等叠加中毒/烧伤/冻伤，三重状态伤害约2回合KO；准备多只精灵轮换。

engine_notes: Innate 物攻+2 (天生强化物攻+2，物攻900左右，消除完为450左右) — clearable.

All skills crit 1/4 of the time (crit_rate_up +2 ≈ 25%, estimate); once its HP is below 10000 every attack is a crit (techbang: 体力降到10000以下时每次攻击必定致命一击) → phase at 76.9% of 13000. 4399 instead says it crits often below 1/4 HP.
Poison, burn, freeze and fatigue work; immune to 寄生种子, 同生共死, 极度冰点.
Cosmetic: 每次攻击后位置会前移 (sprite moves forward) — not modelled.

skills: the solo SPT fight uses species 274 at Lv80, so its set is the last four: 龙之威仪, 猛龙陷地步, 咆哮震九天, 潜龙伏地啸. Solo-fight battle screenshots show 潜龙伏地啸 (4399 2010-09-17, 7k7k 2010-07-30) and 咆哮震九天 (7k7k 2010-07-30); 7k7k 2010-08-16 describes its all-stats -1 move (龙之威仪). 猛龙陷地步 is named for the Lv80 story fight of the same species (7k7k 2011-03-16). The former 灰飞烟灭 is the only move of the team fight's Boss-only form 5001 (2013 client: 2501).
Status damage here follows RULES 7: poison/burn/freeze/leech each take 1/8 max HP per turn (percent damage), and several DoT statuses can be on the boss at once (classic 叠加异常).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
Immune to stat drops: 4399 2010-08-09 lists 免疫属性下降 for 塔克林 (and 塔西亚); no mainland guide lowers its stats. The modern client's Boss trait list carries idx 1 (免疫能力下降), supporting only.
source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-09-26): 血量13000, 天生物攻+2, 可中毒/烧伤/冻伤, 免疫寄生; 4399 2011 summary: 80级.
